## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Safety impact

Describe any filesystem, watcher, configuration, journal, recovery, or execution
boundary affected by this change. State `None` when no safety boundary changes.

## Verification

- [ ] Incremental solution build passes with zero warnings and errors.
- [ ] Relevant focused tests pass.
- [ ] Full suite passes, or the reason it was not run is documented.
- [ ] No real user folders or files were used for testing.
- [ ] Unobserved runtime or UI behavior is marked Not Tested.
